name: Power-law CFG (megapack form)
plain: The scale grows with the size of the guidance difference: each sample gets w_eff = 1 + ω‖Δ‖^α, with ω defaulting to w − 1 so α = 0 gives plain CFG. It runs in noise space by default (velocity on flow models). It differs from the other power-law entry: there is no sigma-dependent rescaling of Δ, no max(·, 1) floor, and the form is anchored at the conditional prediction. The norm is taken over every element of a sample, so ω has to be retuned per model and resolution. The MixScale node's power_law rule calls the same function.
math:
Δ = d_c − d_u in the chosen space (default eps; v on flow models); n = ‖Δ‖ over all non-batch elements.
d̂ = d_c + ω·n^α·Δ, ω = w − 1 when omega = −1.
